subject: Confirm your PEC
body1: To confirm this PEC address as the platform digital domicile that SEND will use as the main address for sending notifications, enter the code on SEND - Servizio Notifiche Digitali
footer: You are receiving this communication because you entered your PEC address as a SEND legal address. To change your contact details or add new ones, href="${ENV.sendLoginUrlPF}recapiti"<#else>href="${ENV.sendLoginUrlPG}recapiti" style="color: #0073e6; text-decoration: underline">go to your contact details.
